events.title: Ecstatica is releasing on October 26th!
events.summary: Celebrate Halloween in TirichWe are happy to announce that Ecstatica will be releasing on October 26th, alongisde its sequel - Ecstatica II. Just before Halloween - the right time to return to a village where everything wants you dead, often in gruesome ways. This is a perfect opportunity to experience this cult survival-horror once again - or for the first time. The re-release makes sure the game runs smoothly on modern systems, and adds several improvements, including full controller support.T

events.title: Ecstatica is coming back!
events.summary: Dear horror enthusiasts!We are happy to announce that in Q4 2026 we will re-release Ecstatica, a cult survival horror classic. Developed by Andrew Spencer Studios and released in 1994, it's known for its pioneering, one-of-a-kind ellipsoid graphics and for combining gory horror with British humour. Around the same time, we will also re-release Ecstatica II, a more action-oriented sequel from the same studio.The re-release will focus on making sure the game runs smoothly on modern systems.
